predictions.articleTitle: Dominica vs Cayman Islands Tactical Breakdown & Probabilistic Modeling: Scoring Floor vs Relegation Block
predictions.coreRecommendation: Project Dominica to avoid defeat in a low-scoring League B finale (Home Win / Draw), anchored by Under 2.5 total goals and BTTS: No.
possibilityAssessment: Primary 1X2 Thesis: Home Win / Draw — Dominica's November scoring floor meets Cayman's five-match League B goal drought, while neutral turf keeps the draw relevant (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
Secondary Total Goals Thesis: Under 2.5 — Low combined lambda expectancy (2.25) and relegation pragmatism point toward 2 or 1 total goals (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
Contingency BTTS Thesis: BTTS: No — Cayman's scoreless League B campaign and Dominica's peer clean sheets favor at least one blank (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Can Dominica's revamped attack breach Cayman Islands' desperate relegation low block?

spf.comment: Derived from the 1:0 primary and 0:0 secondary scripts, pairing Dominica's November scoring edge with the draw because neutral-venue conditions and Cayman's goal-difference incentive make a single Home Win call too exposed to a repeat stalemate.

over_under.comment: Combined lambda expectancy of 2.25 (60.9% Under 2.5) and Cayman Islands' zero goals in five League B matches point to a tight, low-scoring contest.

btts.comment: Cayman Islands carry a five-match scoreless run in Group A against a Dominica side that kept clean sheets versus both Cayman and Anguilla (54.6% Poisson BTTS: No).

score.comment: 1:0 reflects Dominica's top Poisson winning scoreline (12.6%) against a deep block, while 0:0 (10.5%) captures Cayman holding out as in September.

goals.comment: 2 goals (26.7%) and 1 goal (23.7%) represent the two highest-density buckets in the independent Poisson distribution.

bqc.comment: A cautious first half is projected to stay level before either Dominica break through late (Draw-Win) or Cayman preserve a stalemate throughout (Draw-Draw).
